content: The power which resides in him is new in nature, and none but he knows what that is which he can do, nor does he know until he has tried.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Your unique capacity has never existed in history before. You cannot discover the full measure of your power through speculation—only through bold trial.
practicalInsight: Test your limits today by taking on a task you have felt hesitant to attempt.
reflectionPrompt: What latent power in yourself will remain undiscovered unless you try right now?
